label: Hearthside Companion
description: Companion animals doing indoor things — vignettes written for warm interior scenes, never for the wild.

items.name: cat-loaf-windowsill
items.text: a cat folded into a perfect loaf on the windowsill, eyes shut to contented slits, tail wrapped neatly over both front paws

items.name: old-dog-hearth-rug
items.text: an old dog collapsed full-length on the hearth rug with a theatrical sigh, one ear folded inside-out, coat glowing warm at the edges
items.text_short: old dog sprawled on the hearth rug

items.name: kitten-yarn-crime
items.text: a kitten mid-crime in a toppled basket of yarn, one thread unspooled across the floorboards, eyes enormous with rehearsed innocence

items.name: cat-raindrop-watcher
items.text: a cat tracking raindrops down the windowpane with tiny head-flicks, silhouetted against the soft grey light outside
items.text_short: cat watching raindrops on the glass

items.name: dog-blanket-burrow
items.text: a small dog burrowed into a knitted blanket until only the nose and one questioning eyebrow remain visible
items.text_short: dog burrowed into a knitted blanket

items.name: cat-teacup-steam
items.text: a cat inspecting the steam curling off a fresh cup of tea, nose extended, one careful paw already on the table edge

items.name: rabbit-slipper-flop
items.text: a lop-eared rabbit flopped against a sheepskin slipper, ears spilled flat across the floor in total surrender
items.text_short: lop rabbit flopped by a slipper

items.name: dog-window-vigil
items.text: a dog keeping solemn vigil on the window seat, chin resting on the sill, breath fogging one small circle of glass

items.name: cat-bookshelf-wedge
items.text: a cat wedged into the exact bookshelf gap it does not fit, one paw hanging over the shelf edge, profoundly unbothered
items.text_short: cat wedged into a bookshelf gap

items.name: canary-lamp-puff
items.text: a canary puffed into a warm yellow sphere on its perch near the lamp, one eye half-open, feathers loosened with sleep
items.text_short: canary puffed up by the lamp
